summary: Master solar PV project design, finance and operations with practical tools, bankability models, and O&M planning. Enquire now.
lede: Solar PV design training connects resource assessment and plant sizing with yield estimates, project costs and operational planning. It is for professionals involved in solar projects who need to build a coherent plan from feasibility through handover, with practice in developing a design basis, sizing a plant, modelling project cash flows and planning operations and maintenance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work around solar PV projects and need stronger control over design, finance, and operational decisions.
modules: Solar PV Project Context and Bankability
Solar Resource Assessment and Design Basis
Balance of System and Grid Integration
Solar PV Project Finance and Bankability
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a willingness to work with project assumptions, technical datasheets, and simple financial models. Prior exposure to electrical principles, project documents, or renewable energy operations will help you move faster through the exercises.
